response.reconstructed_markdown:
Under the Motor Vehicles \(Amendment\) Act, the penalty for drunk driving \(driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs where blood alcohol exceeds 30 mg per 100 ml of blood\) for a first offence is: [0] [1]

- Fine: Up to ₹10,000
- Imprisonment: Up to 6 months, or both \(fine and imprisonment\)

Details regarding the legal framework can be reviewed further on the [Ministry of Road Transport and Highways](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESUAHrOzAVmd_RPdjrY4iYc35K0UpFFi9Y0v3qGc4C21RpupScG_2fFthMq0QuDDHLyW92aoQ9esMFpVeTwVMdx0Bwh00rZummpE-xJPBrge2H) portal.
